profile.headline: Master of Engineering (M.Eng.) at University of Louisville
profile.summary:
Open to any opportunity for change,  especially those that encourage growth, learning and challenge. Bonus: the company provides training.

Experienced lead software engineer specializing in embedded development, but adaptable to any system, situation and obstacles. Extensive background in process, including design, coding, unit test, integration, qualification testing and maintenance. 

Known for rescuing programs significantly behind schedule.

positions.title: Dog Agility Trial Secretary
positions.description:
Manage dog agility events:
* Data Entry
* File online applications
* Respond to competitor, vendor, and venue queries
* Create schedule of classes
* Pre-event documentation
* Post-event results and reporting
* Front-facing person for the entire event, before, during and after
  - Handle competitor inquiries quickly and politely
* Improve competitor experience by being prompt and efficient
* Advertise events on social media
positions.insights: Skills: Management · Time Management · Organization Skills · Customer Experience · Customer Service

positions.title: Principal Cybersecurity Engineer
positions.description:
•	Develop C code targeting Zynq Ultrascale+ MPSOC
•	Design security architecture for MPSOC to support NSA Type-1 Crypto
•	Information Assurance documentation
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Documentation · Software Coding · Software Integration

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
·	Enhanced test software in JAVA and C++, including slimming interface software, wrote software that auto-generated shared code between JAVA and C++ applications, created shared window code to dynamically create similar windows.
·	Developed model-based C++ software using Rational Rhapsody targeting PowerPC running GreenHills Integrity RTOS
·	Task Leader for a team of three software engineers developing C-based software for an embedded Crypto card.
·	SCRUM Master for a team of six engineers – guided the team through their first Agile software development attempt; worked closely with the Lead Systems engineer to evolve requirements for the software; worked closely with the Lead Integration engineer to resolve software issues that surfaced during Integration and Test resulting in three separate software drops to the customer on schedule and within budget
·	Write, unit test and debug Key Management and Encryption embedded software in C
·	Integrated software from multiple sources; worked closely with the team during integration to resolve issues
·	All deliveries on time or ahead of schedule and on budget resulting in a delivery keeping the overall program on schedule.
·	Worked closely with the Canadian customer during source code evaluation requirements analysis

Staff Software Engineer
·	Task Leader for two F22 efforts (a new development and a maintenance program) 
·	Lead small team through design, coding in C++, integration and test, and delivery 
·	Analyzed and solved customer-reported issues
·	Wrote proposal for customer enhancement requests
·	Created GUIs for Linux-based, multi-level security environment 
·	Designed and developed cross-platform CMS (ASN1) parser

Software Engineer Senior 
·	Wrote device drivers for AIM II, an ARM-based processor 
·	Programmed embedded C software targeting the AIM
·	Developed regression test suite for debugging and certifying SOS, the AIM's operating system
·	Prepared verification/qualification documentation and presented to customer
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Documentation · Software Coding · Software Requirements · Software Integration · Embedded Software Programming

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
*	Programmed embedded C software targeting the Motorola 68302.
*	Developed dynamic bandwidth allocation algorithms.
*	Debugged software in a multi-processor and multi-device environment.
*	Modem design and development for satellite applications
positions.insights: Skills: Software Coding · Embedded Software Programming

positions.title: Multi-disciplined Engineer I
positions.description:
Program Lead
*	Assumed responsibility for software from another engineer.
*	Debugged errors in setting up hardware.
*	Reverse-engineered software to debug integration.
*	Provided task status to superiors using charts.
*	PowerPC 750 Architecture, semi-real-time environment.DSP Software Engineer
*	Coded, debugged, and thoroughly tested software in C.
*	Created reusable software modules for similar tasks in other operations.
*	Implemented software in an array of 30 SHARCs using Virtuoso RTOS.
*	Tasks included calibrating RF signal and creating frequency-domain processing reports.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Coding · Embedded Software Programming
